title: Low-degree open direct-image sequence for adic Weil sheaves
statement:
Fix the finite-field and coefficient datum of [rem-dl-a1-conventions]. Let $X_0$ be a separated [def-weil-proper-morphism] finite-type $k_0$-scheme smooth of relative dimension one [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], and let $j:U_0\hookrightarrow X_0$ be a dense open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion]. Use constructible $\Qlb$-Weil sheaves [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex] with their underlying constructible heart [def-weil-constructible-heart], and ordinary and derived direct images [def-wf-middle-extension, def-weil-derived-direct-image]. For any short exact sequence $0\to G_1\to G\to G_2\to0$ of lisse such sheaves [def-pod-lisse-l-adic-sheaves, def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence], there is a natural exact sequence of constructible Weil sheaves
$$0\to j_*G_1\to j_*G\to j_*G_2\xrightarrow{\delta}R^1j_*G_1.$$
Here $R^1j_*G_1=\mathcal H^1(Rj_*G_1)$ [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves]. All its maps, including $\delta$, are Weil-equivariant. Moreover $R^rj_*G_i=0$ for $r<0$, $R^0j_*G_i=j_*G_i$, $j^*j_*G_i\simeq G_i$, and $j^*R^1j_*G_i=0$. These identifications and the displayed exact sequence commute with restriction to open subschemes of $X_0$. No purity hypothesis is imposed.
